speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: I am not asking for a single dashboard, I am asking for a fully automated chain from observability to alerting that requires formal sign off at every hand over. The current plan leaves too many manual checks in the loop for a system that runs every night.
output.correction: You have filed this as a request for better visualization, but I am talking about the governance of the data flow itself. I need the pipeline to be automated and the transitions to be strictly reviewed, not just easier to look at.
